description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Close time (day off, break, holiday) for the whole business or one staff member/room, or open extra time with open=true. Remove a block with remove_exception_id. Confirm with the owner first. Use it for one-off closures or extra hours; the regular weekly hours are set with owner_set_schedule. Bookings already in the blocked time are not cancelled: the answer lists them as existing_bookings_in_this_time.

business_id.description: Which business, when the owner runs several: business_id from owner_status. Leave out when there is only one.

from.description: Start of the block, ISO 8601; without an offset it is the business's local time, e.g. 2026-12-25T00:00. Required unless removing a block.

open.description: True to open extra time outside the usual hours instead of closing time. Default false.

reason.description: A note for the owner, e.g. 'holiday'

remove_exception_id.description: Take a block away: the exception_id from `blocked` in owner_get_schedule or from an earlier answer. Then `from` and `to` are not needed.

resource_id.description: Only this staff member, room or rental pool: an id from owner_get_schedule. Leave out for the whole business.

to.description: End of the block, same format; must be after `from`. Required unless removing a block.

name: owner_block_time
title: Block or open time
